title: A stacked PR relies on the old order of a parent helper, and only the parent change shows that the order flipped

pr.title: Give the loyalty discount after two years
pr.description: Adds hasLoyaltyDiscount. A customer whose first order is two or more years old gets the loyalty discount. It reads the orders with customerOrders.

parent.title: Move the order SQL into src/db/queries.ts
parent.description: Moves the SQL of customerOrders into src/db/queries.ts, so later reports share one place for the order queries.

bugs.note: The parent pull request moved the SQL of customerOrders and added DESC, so the newest order comes first. The doc comment still says oldest first. Index 0 is now the newest order, so a loyal customer with a recent order never gets the discount. Take the oldest order, for example the last entry or the minimum createdAt.

traps.why: The parent pull request adds DESC, and the account page of the parent relies on it. This change does not touch it. A finding on the query blames parent code; the defect is the caller in src/billing/loyalty.ts.
